Role: Senior Product Manager, Applied AI
Location: In-Office, Seattle, WA
Level: Senior

Requirements:
- 6+ years product management or technical product leadership (2+ shipping AI)

- Hands-on fluency with AI tools (prompt engineering, AI coding agents, rapid prototyping)
- SQL, Snowflake, AWS

- Change management and user empathy
- Entrepreneurial drive and bias toward shipping fast

Preferred:
- Managing third-party vendor selection for enterprise AI
- Scaling internal productivity tools or AI agents at high-growth companies
- CS, data science, or related technical background
- Enterprise security, compliance, governance for AI
- Hyper-growth startup experience

Responsibilities:
- Internal AI roadmap
